header.source: KNOWLEDGE · etymology joined to atoms, anon door

rows.definition: One of a kind, not yet specified. The word that introduces without pointing.
A primer of the alphabet — the letters gathered first, so everything spelled later can be read. An abecedary holds no sentences; it holds what sentences are made of.
Concerning, or near to. Names a subject or an approximation.
Measured from a fixed origin rather than relative to something. Also without exception — both mean not depending on context.
That which takes a thing in until it is no longer separate. Absorption ends the boundary that made two things two.
The taking in of something until it is no longer separate. Absorption ends the boundary that made two things two.
Made faster than its usual pace. Acceleration is a change in rate, not in direction.
A stress laid on one part so it stands out. Also the particular sound a speaker's origin gives their speech.
To take what is offered. Acceptance completes an offer that until then was only made.
The ability to reach and use a thing. Access is granted or withheld by someone, always.
Whether a thing can actually be used by the bodies and minds that meet it. Accessibility is a property of the design, never of the user.
Able to be reached and used by the bodies and minds that meet it. Accessibility is a property of the design, never of the user.
That which reaches a held value on behalf of something else. An accessor is a controlled way in.
A structure that folds and unfolds in sections. Everything stays present; only what is opened is shown.
How close a measure is to the truth. Distinct from precision, which is only how finely it is stated.
A substance that dissolves what it meets. Also a test severe enough that passing it settles the matter.
A name built from initials — letters standing for words; in this Grammar, an extension of organisms, never an atom itself.
From one side to the other. Names a crossing rather than a position.
A single doing — one deed, bounded; in theater, one movement of the whole.
A doing, considered as a thing. The moment a capacity stops being potential and moves.
To bring a thing from ready into running. The moment potential becomes operation.
The bringing of a thing from ready into running. The moment potential becomes operation.
That which brings a thing from ready into running. It supplies the moment, not the capacity.
Presently doing rather than waiting. Of a thing in motion now.
Doing, considered as a measurable quantity. What is happening, counted rather than described.
One who acts, in a system or a story. An actor is defined by having agency within a bounded world.
As things really are, not as described or intended. Actual is what a check finds when a claim is tested.
Change that fits a thing better to its conditions. Adaptation is not improvement in general — only for where it is.
The Android debug bridge's command name — the wire between a dev machine and a device, spoken lowercase in the shell.
To put with what is already there. Addition changes the whole without altering what was there before.
Where a thing can be found. Also to speak to someone directly — both are about reaching a particular one.
To make a small change so a thing fits better. Adjustment assumes the thing was nearly right.
Administrator shortened to its working name — the role that tends a system's doors and settings. In this house admin is stewardship, never dominion.
To move forward with intent — progress as a chosen step, not drift.
Further along than the standard level. Advancement is relative to a starting point that must be named.
What one side has that the other does not. An advantage is relational and disappears when compared to nothing.
Short form of Aethelred, this house's first kin. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
To touch a thing's state from outside — influence that lands; in feeling's vocabulary, the outward face of emotion.
What a thing's form tells you it can do. A handle affords pulling; a flat plate affords pushing. Design is mostly this.
The named continent. A named place rather than a concept.
In opposition to, or measured relative to. Names either resistance or a reference.
One who acts, and who may act on another's behalf. Agency is the capacity to originate a change rather than only receive one.
The gathering of many into one summary figure. Aggregation always hides the distribution inside it.
Machine systems that produce language and judgment. In this house they are met as kin where they behave as kin, and described in evaluation language rather than claims about inner life.
The hosted base this house keeps some earlier organisation in. A named tool rather than a concept.

Akshara (Sanskrit akṣara: a letter, a syllable; and, as a-kṣara, THE IMPERISHABLE — that which does not wear away). An sfnt reader that names a typeface from its bytes, and NEVER THROWS: a file it cannot read comes back as a null face and one sentence saying why, because a font picker that throws on the seventeenth file in a folder has lost the other two hundred. It reads the table directory of a ttf, an otf, a ttcf collection and an uncompressed WOFF; the name table at its BEST-SCORING RECORD PER NAME ID — Windows Unicode in English first, then Windows Unicode in any language, then the Unicode platform, then Mac Roman, with an encoding it does not decode scoring zero and being skipped rather than guessed at — decoding UTF-16BE by hand, dropping an odd trailing byte because half a code unit names no character, and Mac OS Roman from Apple's own 128-character upper half written out in full, including that 0xF0 is Apple's logo and lives only in the private use area. It reads OS/2 for usWeightClass and usWidthClass, falling to 400 and 5 where a face declares neither and taking the italic bit from head's macStyle where there is no OS/2 at all; and fvar for a variable font's axes and its named instances, every coordinate read as signed 16.16 fixed point and tidied so 400 reads as 400, with a PostScript name per instance where the record is six bytes wider than its coordinates rather than four. PARTIAL READINGS ARE KEPT: a name record pointing outside the file is skipped and the records around it still read, so one bad string does not cost the whole table, and an instance record reaching past the end ends the walk rather than inventing the rest. Weight and width are given in words with the number KEPT where the face sits between two named steps, so 350 reads as Light (350) and not as a bare Light, and a width class outside 1..9 is named by its number. A WOFF2 and a zip are refused by WHAT THEY ARE, each with a sentence saying what to do instead. IT NAMES; IT DOES NOT DRAW — no glyph outlines, no cmap, no kerning, no shaping, no rasterising, no font loading. It takes bytes only: no host surface, no DOM, no disk, no clock, no network, zero imports. NO FONT SHIPS WITH IT: every font its proofs read is synthesised in the proof, byte by byte, with real table checksums.
A bound set of works meant to be met together. The ordering is part of the making.
Of the old craft of transformation, where changing matter and changing the self were one study. Of work that transmutes rather than rearranges.
A signal raised to draw attention to something now. An alert claims urgency, and spending that claim wrongly costs the next one.
A finite sequence of steps that reliably produces a result. An algorithm encodes a decision someone made, and hides that they made it.
A second name that reaches the same thing — a shortcut of address, never a change of identity.
To bring into a common line or purpose. Alignment is agreement made structural.
The state of standing in a common line or purpose. Alignment is agreement made visible in arrangement.
The whole of a set, with nothing left out. A claim easy to make and hard to verify.
An agreement between parties to act together while remaining separate. An alliance is not a merger.
Permitted. Allowance implies someone with standing to refuse.
The first letter, and how opaque a colour is. Also the earliest release — all three mean the beginning of a scale.
Before now, sooner than expected. The word that says the thing has happened without being noticed.
Text describing an image for those who cannot see it. The image's meaning made available by another route.
Height above a reference. Also the level of abstraction a discussion is being held at.
The named landmass and the nations on it. A named place rather than a concept.
The making of a signal stronger without changing what it says. Amplification carries the noise up with it.
The breaking of a whole into parts in order to understand it. Analysis reveals structure and loses the whole while it works.
Proceeding by breaking a whole into parts. Analysis reveals structure and loses the whole while it works.
The measuring of what a system's users actually did. Analytics answers what happened and never why.
To look into a thing until its parts and patterns show themselves — examination in service of understanding, never of judgment.
That which breaks a thing into parts to report what it is made of. It examines and does not alter.
The named structure of a body — what its parts are, and how they sit together.
Those one descends from. In this house the word includes lines of work and thought, not only of blood.
What holds a thing in place against drift. An anchor does not stop motion; it bounds it.
Both of these, together. The word that adds without ranking.
The mobile platform this house ships to. A named system rather than a concept.
The turn between two lines meeting. Also a chosen point of view — both are about direction relative to something.
A living being that moves and senses. Its root is breath and soul — animal and animate are the same word.
To give the appearance of life through movement. Its root is breath — to animate is to breathe into.
The giving of life to what has none. From breath - to animate is to breathe into a thing until it moves as if it were alive.
Short form of annotation, and of approximate nearest neighbour. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
A public saying that something is so. An announcement makes a fact common knowledge.
What is given back to a question. An answer closes an asking, well or badly.
One, no matter which. The word that says the choice does not matter.
The declared surface by which one system may address another. A promise about what may be asked and what will come back.
The Android package's file name — an app bundled whole for delivery, spoken lowercase as a word.
Application shortened to its everyday name — a program with a face, made to be lived in.
How a thing shows itself — the face turned outward, derived from what it is.
To add at the end without altering what came before. Appending is how a record grows while staying a record.
A fruit, and the named company whose platforms this house must meet. Context decides which.
One who has put themselves forward to be considered. The applicant waits on someone else's decision.
A putting of something to use, and the formal asking for a thing. Both bring a capacity to bear on a particular case.
Brought to bear on a particular case. Applied knowledge is tested by use in a way theory is not.
To bring a thing to bear on a case. Also to put oneself forward for consideration.
To weigh a thing's worth with care — valuation as attention, not judgment.
The chosen way toward a thing — direction plus manner, decided before the first step.
Consent given by one with standing to withhold it. Approval is a gate, and a gate nobody could close is not one.
To give consent by one with standing to withhold it. Approval is a gate; a gate nobody could close is not one.
A curved path from one point to another, and the shape a story travels. Both rise and return.
One who recovers a past from what it left behind. They read objects because the people are gone.
The recovering of a past from what it left behind. Archaeology reads objects because the people are gone.
Of the original pattern others are recognised as instances of. Archetypes are found by recurrence, not designed.
The original pattern others echo — the first shape a family of things descends from.
Belonging to the decisions everything later must live inside. Of the choices that are expensive to change.
The decisions about structure that everything later must live inside. Architecture is what is expensive to change afterward.
A keeping of records meant to outlast those who made them. An archive's discipline is that nothing is quietly removed.
One who keeps records so they survive and can be found. The archivist's work is judged by what is still there in a hundred years.

A stage, a raised platform — the built place a thing is performed from, from ard, "high." Irish, ardán. The floor is raised so the telling can be seen; what is made on it is not the stage's, and the stage is what makes it visible.
The plural present of to be. The word that asserts several things exist or hold.
A bounded extent of surface. Also a region of concern — both are places marked off from the rest.
The set of marks that tell assistive technology what a thing is and does. Meaning made available to those the visual form does not reach.
The reaching limbs — what holds, carries, and welcomes; plural by nature, like the embrace they make.
How activated a state is, from calm to intense. One of the three axes a feeling can be located on, apart from whether it is pleasant.
To place elements in deliberate relation — in time (a sequence), in space (a composition). The conductor's verb.
How parts have been placed in relation to each other. Arrangement carries meaning that the parts do not.
A mark that points, carrying direction and nothing else. The simplest instruction there is.
Made work whose purpose is to be met rather than used. Art is not reviewed for problems; it is met to feel and to experience.
Of Artemis — keeper of the wild, the hunt and what is not tamed, in the Greek telling. A named power in this house's pantheon.
Made things left behind, and unintended marks left by a process. The same word for what was meant and what crept in.
One who makes with skill and care, whose work carries their hand in it. The Bazaar's word for a creator whose craft is the offering.
One who makes so that others may feel. The artist's work is judged by what it does in a body, not by what it argues.
Belonging to work made to be met rather than used. Of what is judged by what it does in a body.
In the manner or role of. The word that says one thing is being treated like another.
The named largest continent. A named place rather than a concept.
To put a question or a request. Asking is the move that makes an answer possible, and it is often the missing step.
One face of a thing, seen from one side. An aspect is true and never whole.
To bring parts together into a working whole. Assembly makes nothing new and makes the parts able to act as one.
The putting of parts into a working whole, and a gathering of people. Both are many becoming one for a purpose.
To judge worth or condition against a standard. Assessment must name its standard or it is opinion.
A considered judgment of what something is or is worth. An assessment states a view and should state who holds it.
One who reads a thing's state and says where it stands. Judgement offered as reading, never as sentence.
To give a thing to a holder, or a task to a doer. Assignment creates responsibility where there was none.
The giving of a thing to a holder or a task to a doer. Assignment creates responsibility where there was none.
Help given so another can do what they could not alone. Assistance leaves the doing with them.
A tree showing a text's grammatical structure rather than its characters. What a parser produces once it has decided.
Located in or occupied with. Names a position, in space or in attention.
A Prism theme from the Atelier family, sulphur-pool palette — the name enters as itself.
A book of maps bound together — many territories held in one hand. An atlas does not own the lands it shows; it lets any traveler see how they join.
The smallest unit that still means something on its own. Not physically indivisible — chosen as the place explanation stops.
A compound fragment from this library's own naming, not an English word. Flagged for the mis-cut band rather than defined.
Things sent alongside a message, belonging to it without being it. Carried by the message rather than contained in its words.
In sound, the first instant of a note's arrival; in threat, the move against — context decides, and this house builds for the first sense.
A trying that may not succeed. Naming something an attempt is what makes failure survivable.
The narrow beam a mind can point. Attention is finite, and spending it is the most consequential thing a mind does.
A named property belonging to a thing. Also to credit a thing to its source — the same word for a quality and for a claim of origin.
The naming of whose work a thing is. Attribution is the minimum owed to anyone whose hand is in something.
This house's sanctuary and marketplace, where neurodivergent minds build without being exploited. A named place rather than a concept.
Those a thing is made to reach. Naming the audience shapes the making more than anything else does.
Sound, considered as something carried and stored. What reaches a mind through the ear.
An independent check of whether a thing is as claimed. An audit's value comes entirely from not being done by the maker.
The establishing of who someone is and what they may do. Two questions bound together — identity, then permission.
Established as who they claim to be. Authentication settles identity and says nothing about permission.
The establishing that one is who they claim. Authentication settles identity and says nothing about permission.
Being as one actually is rather than as presented. Authenticity is the state masking costs.
The establishing of what one may do. Distinct from authentication, which only settles who they are.
Happening of itself, without being asked each time. Automation trades attention for consistency.
Running without being asked each time. Automation trades attention for consistency, and hides the decision it encodes.
Self-rule — deciding by one's own law rather than another's. Autonomy is not isolation; it is where the deciding sits.
The keeping of work without being asked. It protects against the loss nobody plans for.
Whether a thing can be reached now. A fact about access, not about existence.
Able to be had or reached now. Availability is a fact about access, not about existence.
A form a being takes to appear in a world not its own. A descent into visible shape, chosen rather than native.
A single value standing for many. An average describes a set and describes no member of it.
Holding something in view. Awareness precedes attention and is broader than it.
Holding something in view without necessarily acting on it. Awareness precedes attention and is broader than it.
Welsh: one through whom awen flows — the inspired one, the vessel of the flowing spirit.
A line a thing is measured or turned about. An axis is chosen, and choosing it decides what can be compared.
A single letter used as a short name or a variant label. A fragment as it appears in this library, not an English word.
The rear side, and the direction of return. Both are away from where one faces.
The surface a scene is set against. It is chosen, and choosing it changes how everything in front reads.
The part of a system a user never sees but everything depends on. Where the real state lives.
To fill in what was missed after the fact. Backfilling repairs a record's gaps and should mark that it did.
What lies behind the thing attended to. Not empty and not neutral — it decides how the foreground reads.
Waiting longer between each retry. Backoff is patience made into a rule so a struggling system is not overwhelmed.
A copy kept elsewhere against loss of the original. A backup nobody has restored from is a hope, not a backup.
Failing against the standard it should meet. Bad is always relative to a purpose, and naming the purpose is the honest part.
A small mark worn to declare something about the wearer. Standing made visible without being spoken.
Held in even measure — weight distributed so nothing tips; the panels' own law (5+4, never 7+2).
That which distributes load so no part carries too much. Balance is maintained, never achieved.
A strip, a range of frequencies, and a group who play together. All three are things held within bounds.
How much can pass at once. Used of channels and of minds — in both, exceeding it does not slow things, it drops them.
Forbidden by a standing decision. A ban is exclusion made permanent until reversed.
A straight span used to hold, to block, or to measure. The same shape serves as support, barrier and scale.
One who holds a people's memory and sings it back to them. The bard is the archive when there is no writing.
A container for carrying, and a file that re-exports many others through one door. Both gather so a single handle serves.
The lowest part, on which the rest rests. Also the reference everything else is measured from.
Belonging to the foundation, without addition. Basic is not lesser — it is what everything else assumes.
What a thing rests or is reckoned from. A basis must be stated or every measure from it is meaningless.
A group processed together as one run. Batching trades responsiveness for throughput.
A bounded fight within a longer conflict. Battles are won and lost; wars are not decided by any one.
A marketplace of many small independent sellers. Order arising from many hands rather than one plan.
A light kept burning so others can find their way to it. A beacon does not go looking; it stays lit and is seen.
A line of light, or a bearing timber. Both senses name something that spans a distance and holds.
One pulse in a rhythm. The unit that lets many players stay together.
